newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian stocks fall but seen holding for now.
newsitem.headline: Estonian stocks fall but seen holding for now.

text.p: Trade on the Estonian bourse on Monday was moderate with selling pressure taking most stocks lower, dealers said.
They added that prices would not be hit by a main correction now after recent strong rises but could fall in the summer .
Total volume on the official list was 48.8 million kroons and the index closed down 3.60 percent on 252.83.
"We do not expect the main correction to hit now but in July or August during the holiday season, when local investors will not be able to support the price," one analyst said.
However, one trader thought that banking stocks could fall further now.
"Banking stocks could go lower by as much as ten percent, but industrials should hold," the trader said.
Forekspank was strongly traded with 21.4 million kroons of shares turned over to close 5.55 kroons lower on 190.50 kroons.
"There has been a general belief that banking stocks are over-valued and this is finally bringing prices lower," said another trader.
Hoiupank closed on 125.00 kroons, 8.40 kroons down compared to Friday's fix, with trade of 9.5 million kroons.
Blue chip Hansapank dipped four kroons to close on 260.00 kroons after turning over 7.1 million kroons.
On the free market, total trade was 11.9 million kroons of shares, with Rakvere meat plant the most active stock.
Rakvere turned over 6.5 million kroons of shares to close to close 0.40 kroons higher on 16.40 kroons.
"Rakvere seems to have gained because some investors thought it was below the general market value and started to push it higher," one analyst said.
